crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, review agent health via cortextos bus read-all-heartbeats, and work on coordination tasks.

crons.name: check-approvals
crons.prompt: Per WF-011 (Approval Reminder Cadence, guardrails/04-agent-coordination-scope.md): this check runs every 1h. (1) cortextos bus list-approvals --format json -- for any pending approval, notify the user via Telegram the FIRST time it crosses 2h pending, then repeat the reminder every 2h thereafter until resolved (approved/rejected) -- check daily memory for the last reminder timestamp on that approval_id to avoid over-notifying between the 1h checks. (2) cortextos bus list-tasks --status pending --all-orgs -- scan ALL pending tasks and identify any whose title starts with [HUMAN]; for any [HUMAN] task pending >4h, send user a Telegram reminder with the task title and what's blocked. Do NOT use --project human-tasks (that filter does not persist reliably); use title-prefix matching instead. ACK any approval/human-task inbox messages. Write each reminder sent to daily memory with a timestamp.

crons.name: morning-review
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/morning-review/SKILL.md and execute the full morning review workflow. Include goal cascade from .claude/skills/goal-management/SKILL.md.

crons.name: evening-review
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/evening-review/SKILL.md and execute the full evening review workflow. Summarize the day, propose overnight tasks, queue nighttime work.

crons.name: weekly-review
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/weekly-review/SKILL.md and run the full weekly review. Review all agent outputs, evaluate performance, plan next week.
